There
are
perhaps
three
ways
of
looking
at
furniture
:
some
people
see
it
as
purely
functional
and
useful
,
and
don't
bother
themselves
with
aesthetics
;
others
see
it
as
essential
to
civilised
living
and
concern
themselves
with
design
and
how
the
furniture
will
look
in
a
room
.
In
other
words
,
function
combined
with
aesthetics
;
and
yet
others
see
furniture
as
a
form
of
art
